experiencePlan.opening: Pictures Of Matchstick Men is performed by The Status Quo.
experiencePlan.closing: The Status Quo's "Pictures Of Matchstick Men" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Pictures of Matchstick Men" is the first hit single by British rock band the Status Quo. The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.
